name: Mega Fin (India) Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1982, Mega Fin (India) Ltd is in the business of providing financial services[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
MFIL is a core investment company with services in financing and advancing short term and long term loans and credits to individuals and companies, merchant banking; commercial financing; stock broking, and other activities in financial services.

cons: Stock is trading at 12.5 times its book value
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 6.40% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 7.70% over last 3 years.
